title: Things to Do (for the weekend of August 15th)
description:
Looking for things to do in Los Angeles? Celebrate Pride in San Pedro, experience Japanese culture in Little Tokyo, or dance to classic soul and R&B at Warner Park!

San Pedro Pride Festival 2026
Celebrate with Bridge Cities Alliance at AltaSea with live performances, children’s activities, face painting, and an after-party for guests ages 21 and older.

📅 Saturday, August 15
⏰ 4–10 p.m.
📍 AltaSea at the Port of Los Angeles
🔗 https://www.sanpedropride.com/

Nisei Week Grand Parade
Celebrate Japanese culture and heritage in Downtown L.A.’s historic Little Tokyo. The annual parade features Japanese dancers, community groups, live performances, and colorful floats.

📅 Sunday, August 16
⏰ Begins at 4 p.m.
📍 Little Tokyo
🔗 https://niseiweek.org/

Super Soul Groove at Warner Park
Dance to hits made famous by the Temptations, the Commodores, Aretha Franklin, James Brown, Earth, Wind & Fire, and more. Emerging artist The 90’s Babiez will open the show.

📅 Sunday, August 16
📍 Warner Park
🔗 https://valleycultural.org/

Discover what’s happening throughout your city!
